elements.label: Table 4.6
elements.title: Possible Setups for the Null and Alternative Hypotheses for a Population Mean (One Sample)
elements.details:
| Setup A | Setup B | Setup C |
|---------|---------|---------|
| H₀ : μ = k | H₀ : μ ≤ k | H₀ : μ ≥ k |
| Hₐ : μ ≠ k | Hₐ : μ > k | Hₐ : μ < k |
elements.summary: This table shows three possible setups for null and alternative hypotheses when conducting a one-sample hypothesis test for a population mean, with different inequality relations.
